title: Solana Foundation Grants
description: Milestone-based grants for public goods on Solana, plus milestone-based convertible grants for public goods with a commercial component. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Categories on the form: AI, Consumer, DeFi, Developer Education and Ecosystem, Developer Tooling.
reward: Milestone-based grants; the amount is requested by the applicant and not capped on the page
ideas: Open-source developer tooling only possible on Solana
A free community offering for Solana builders
A fully onchain perps venue with open source contracts

eligibility.note: a public good, meaning a significant open source contribution to the Solana ecosystem or a free community offering

each_time: a public good and open source answer
rules: Rolling: all applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Review takes about one week; decision and contracting about three weeks.

Standard grants are milestone-based grants for public goods. A project counts as a public good if it makes a significant open-source contribution to the Solana ecosystem or has a meaningful free community offering; a novel proof of concept may also qualify.
Projects that are primarily commercial usually won't qualify for a standard grant; they should consider a convertible grant, applied for through the same form.
A convertible grant converts to an investment only if the project reaches set milestones, such as raising a priced round or completing growth objectives.
The Foundation evaluates: public good, open source, only possible on Solana, and a clear use of funds with measurable milestones.
Write answers out in the fields; do not paste website links into questions that do not ask for them.
Developer Tooling applicants write a proposal in a shared Google Doc following the Foundation's guidelines and share the link instead of the standard questions.
If you are building a perps product, choose DeFi. Marking a non-perps project as perps gets the application denied.
Not everyone receives a reply; no reply means the project is not a fit for funding at this time. Approvals are at the discretion of the Solana Foundation Capital Team.

submission_requirements.label: Solana On-Chain Accounts
submission_requirements.description: Insert this project's on-chain addresses (program ID, token address, fee payer wallets etc.). Separate them using a comma.

submission_requirements.label: Funding Amount
submission_requirements.description: How much are you requesting in funding? A number.

submission_requirements.label: Which funding category are you applying for?
Developer Tooling Instructions
submission_requirements.description: Shown and required only when the category is Developer Tooling: a proposal in a shared Google Doc following the Foundation's Developer Tooling guidelines. It replaces the questions below up to Why You.

submission_requirements.label: Your project / idea
submission_requirements.description: Required unless the category is Developer Tooling. What are you building? If you were referred by a Solana Foundation Partner or by someone at Solana Foundation, please indicate below.

submission_requirements.label: Is / will this project be open sourced?
submission_requirements.description: Required unless the category is Developer Tooling.

submission_requirements.label: Specify the amount of funding you are requesting and list the milestones that will be completed to unlock each portion of that funding.
submission_requirements.description: Required unless the category is Developer Tooling. Measurable milestones for both Product Development and Adoption, each with the amount it unlocks.

guidance.pattern: $1,000 due upon completion of Milestone 1 deliverable, then $2,000 for Milestone 2, each a measurable result

submission_requirements.label: Relevant metrics about the usage of your project/product
submission_requirements.description: Required unless the category is Developer Tooling. Tell us about the traction that your project has already achieved.

submission_requirements.label: Competition
submission_requirements.description: Required unless the category is Developer Tooling. Who is a direct competitor to your project? Tell us your competitive advantage.

submission_requirements.label: How is this project a public good?
submission_requirements.description: Required unless the category is Developer Tooling. A significant open-source contribution to the Solana ecosystem, or a meaningful free community offering; a novel proof of concept may also qualify.

submission_requirements.label: Are you building a perps product?
submission_requirements.description: Shown and required only when the category is DeFi. The Foundation backs perps that are fully onchain, with real price discovery, Solana-first, open source and built by experienced teams.

submission_requirements.label: Why You?
submission_requirements.todo: the reason the team is best placed
submission_requirements.description: Why are you and your team the best people to build this project? What edge do you have over the competition?
